entities.summary: Dominik Bokk is a German professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for Kölner Haie of the German Ice Hockey League (DEL). A top prospect going into the 2018 NHL entry draft, Bokk was selected 25th overall by the St. Louis Blues and was traded to the Carolina Hurricanes the following year, but has not played in any NHL games.
